answer: Admission credentials arrive encrypted and need five of nine trustees to decrypt, so no single server can mint identities alone and a compromised trustee cannot open the gate. A farm must bribe five trustees per credential batch, and each bribed trustee is visible in the public decryption log, while honest credentials decrypt on schedule. The forge of the design is public, the sparrow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the pulse of honest work is what finally pays.
